information: Welcome to the first ever competition in Durango, Colorado!! All competitors must read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png) **On-the-spot registration is NOT enabled** for this competition! Live results, group assignments, and a more in-depth schedule can be found on the [Important Day-of Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FourCornersOrientationCO2026#79522-important-day-of-information) tab.
